package nullfields_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/nullfields/gen/TRANSPORT/nullfields/client"
	server "example.com/nullfields/gen/TRANSPORT/nullfields/server"
	svc "example.com/nullfields/gen/nullfields"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestSelectedNullAndAbsence(t *testing.T) {
	var calls atomic.Int32
	echo := func(_ context.Context, value any) (any, error) {
		calls.Add(1)
		return value, nil
	}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(&svc.Endpoints{Echo: echo, Ambiguous: echo, RootAny: echo, RootNullable: echo}, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, SERVER_OPTIONS))
	host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer host.Close()
	c := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(host.URL, "http://"), host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	for _, wire := range []string{
		`{"required_any":null,"required_nullable":null}`,
		`{"required_any":null,"required_nullable":null,"optional_any":null,"optional_nullable":null,"list":[null,"text"],"map":{"n":null,"v":true},"outer":null}`,
		`{"required_any":"text","required_nullable":true,"optional_any":0,"optional_nullable":"value","outer":1}`,
	} {
		t.Run(wire, func(t *testing.T) {
			var payload svc.Record
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(wire), &payload))
			require.NotEmpty(t, payload.RequiredAny.Kind())
			require.NotEmpty(t, payload.RequiredNullable.Kind())
			if strings.Contains(wire, `"optional_any"`) {
				require.NotEmpty(t, payload.OptionalAny.Kind())
			} else {
				require.Empty(t, payload.OptionalAny.Kind())
			}
			before := calls.Load()
			result, err := c.Echo()(t.Context(), &payload)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, before+1, calls.Load())
			require.Equal(t, &payload, result)
			output, err := json.Marshal(result, json.Deterministic(true))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.JSONEq(t, wire, string(output))
		})
	}
	for _, wire := range []string{`null`, `"text"`, `0`} {
		var payload svc.AnyChoice
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(wire), &payload))
		result, err := c.RootAny()(t.Context(), &payload)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, &payload, result)
	}
	for _, wire := range []string{`null`, `"text"`, `true`} {
		var payload svc.NullableChoice
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(wire), &payload))
		result, err := c.RootNullable()(t.Context(), &payload)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, &payload, result)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ method, wire string }{
		{"echo", `{}`},
		{"echo", `{"required_any":true,"required_nullable":null}`},
		{"ambiguous", `null`},
	} {
		t.Run("reject "+tc.method+tc.wire, func(t *testing.T) {
			before := calls.Load()
			path, body := "/"+tc.method, tc.wire
			if IS_RPC {
				path = "/rpc"
				body = `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"` + tc.method + `","params":` + tc.wire + `}`
			}
			response, err := host.Client().Post(host.URL+path, "application/json", strings.NewReader(body))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			raw, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
			if IS_RPC {
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.StatusCode)
				require.Contains(t, string(raw), `"code":-32602`)
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, response.StatusCode, string(raw))
			}
			require.Equal(t, before, calls.Load())
		})
	}
}
